title: MIN-116 [BUILD] Flash settlement: x402 micropayment + badge

rework_resolutions.item_1_g1_challenge_binding: RESOLVED: All signed payment fields (challenge_id, deal_id, payer, recipient, amount, currency, nonce) strictly validated against the 402 challenge. Adversarial substitution tests confirm rejection.
rework_resolutions.item_2_g3_positive_finite_amounts: RESOLVED: Strict math.isfinite(amount) and amount > 0 validation enforced across all entrypoints. Negative, zero, NaN, and +/- Inf amounts rejected with INVALID_AMOUNT; cannot reduce weekly_spent.
rework_resolutions.item_3_g3_weekly_cap_proof: RESOLVED: Sequential transactions exhaust rolling weekly cap (3x90=270 settled within 300 cap). Fourth transaction of 50 within per-task cap is rejected with WEEKLY_CAP_EXCEEDED and logged.
rework_resolutions.item_4_g4_git_coordinates: RESOLVED: Stale hardcoded commit/tree hashes purged from EVIDENCE.json. Canonical git coordinates (repo_url and branch) verified by suite; exact commit/tree hashes published in Protocol Phi handoff envelope.
rework_resolutions.item_5_regression_test_suite: RESOLVED: 20 comprehensive Python unit and regression tests added in test_regression.py covering field mismatch, amount edge cases, weekly cap, and git coordinates.
